data.name: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
data.detailed_description:
Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer!  Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels in 10 worlds. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!  The demo (releasing Sept 2026) allows players to participate in the first two world's leaderboards against other players - even those playing in the full release version.  I aim to support progress migration from the demo to the full launch version to carry over cloud save progress.

Save the earth and precious elemental spritelings from the clutches of Dr Uber Apocalypse by stringing together your moves as combos.  There are secrets in every level, accessories to customize SAM, leaderboards to climb, and even new skills to obtain by saving spritelings!

Key Features

  • 3D Combo Platformer

Jump.  Double Jump.  Spin.  Roll.  Super Jump.  Slam.  Wall Jump.  Wall Skip.  Dash.  Glide.

These are all the moves SAM can do straight out of the box, with seamless interweaving between all of these actions.  Special timing of move combinations may even yield some Super Awesome results.

  • Daily Climb (Online)

Every day, a new daily challenge is added to the Daily Climb mode with its own unique leaderboard.  See if you're today's hero in this daily randomized vertical behemoth!  In the full version of the game, this mode will yield unique accessories for consistent participants.

  • Infinite Hacker Mode

Looking for a never-ending, increasingly difficult platformer challenge?  This unique mode isn't about time, but how many floppy discs you can grab before the evil AI's firewall catches up to SAM!  A special leaderboard tracks who has retrieved the most floppy discs in a single run.

Additional Features

  • Steam Leaderboards

EVERY. LEVEL. HAS. A. LEADERBOARD.  Even the tutorial levels!  Compete with players from all over to see who can get the fastest time.  Pick your favorite SAM profile picture, see your personal best splits, and rise to the top!

  • Discord Integrations

Every time a new, world-breaking fastest time is achieved on the leaderboard, automation pushes that notification to our Discord community.  This lets everyone know real-time who is the best in the world!

  • Ultrawide Support & Steam Deck Support & Potato PC Support

This game supports aspect ratios up to 32:9!  Steam Deck performance is a priority as well, along with ensuring that even low power mini PCs have a smooth experience.

  • Offline Mode

Want to just play a platformer without all the online leaderboard and Discord aspects but still want Steam Cloud saving?  Sure, just enable offline mode!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.6 GHz Quad Core or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon HD 7970
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.8.14
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz (up to 448 GFlops FP32)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 RDNA 2 CUs, 1.6GHz (1.6 TFlops FP32)
